column1: # Selections for scripts/fightin.py: each row is its own experiment, with its own sample of AI documents (English
# and Chinese) that match it, its own embeddings and comparison: results/fightin/<name>_<N in thousands>k/.
# scripts/go_fightin.sh submits one job per row. name: letters, digits, _. pattern: regex on title and text,
# case-insensitive (empty: every AI document). from/to: dates, YYYY-MM-DD (English documents: CC-NEWS crawl date).
